# Toni Anev - LLM Full Context

## Identity

Toni Anev is a Principal Software Engineer, AI, at Okta (since Sep 2026). From Jul 2023 to Sep 2026 Toni was at Sanofi, rising from Software Engineering Lead to ML Engineering Lead, R&D AI Engineering. Based in Toronto, ON, Canada.

## Public Positioning

- Founded Sanofi's first AI engineering organization and scaled it from zero to 70+ people across Toronto, Paris, and Boston (7 direct reports, 30+ FTEs, 40+ contractors), reporting to the VP of R&D.
- Has built ML platforms, LLM systems, and the engineering standards for reliable production delivery (Sanofi, Petco, Loblaw).
- Proven across pharma (Sanofi), retail (Petco, Loblaw), ad tech (Loblaw Media), and market research (Numeris).

## Public Highlights

### Okta (Sep 2026 - present) - Principal Software Engineer, AI

- Current role. No Okta work is described on this site.

### Sanofi (Jul 2023 - Sep 2026) - Software Engineering Lead -> ML Engineering Lead, R&D AI Engineering

- Founded Sanofi's first AI engineering organization; scaled to 70+ globally across Toronto, Paris, and Boston.
- Defined and executed the global AI infrastructure strategy: $12M+ HPC platform on NVIDIA A100/H100, EKS, FSx Lustre, and S3 - secured over a competing corporate platform through alignment with R&D, IT Security, Legal, and Finance.
- Delivered platform architecture and budget strategy to SVP stakeholders within 6 weeks; blueprints and Terraform modules adopted by Vaccines and Small Molecule R&D as Sanofi's internal reference.
- Shipped an event-driven LLM platform for automated clinical data analysis: vLLM-served models with FP8 quantization on ECS, EventBridge, and AWS Batch, with manifest-driven orchestration that scales to zero between workloads.
- Standardized Terraform IaC and automated provisioning: 23% throughput improvement.
- Operationalized protein models via SageMaker and Bedrock: time-to-production down 26% across 7+ R&D teams.
- Incident frequency down 50%+; onboarding time down 40% via standardized CI/CD and async-first documentation.

### Petco, via ShyftLabs (Jan 2023 - Jun 2023) - Technology Lead, Customer AI

- Managed a $5M ML infrastructure budget across a 5-person engineering team; MLOps standards on GCP (GKE, Dataproc, Cloud Composer); deployment cycles down 25%.
- Directed a $3M personalization program: recommendation engine combining clickstream, transactional, and product data - 3% basket-size uplift, $13M/month incremental revenue.
- Redesigned the price-elasticity platform on Snowflake, Vertex AI, Airflow, and Seldon: runtime 24h -> 4h, compute load down 32%.

### Loblaw (Jan 2019 - Jan 2023) - Data Engineer -> Senior Data Engineer -> Senior MLOps Engineer

- Architected a promotion optimization platform serving 16 divisions and 200+ product categories (GCP Dataproc, Terraform, Airflow, Azure DevOps CI/CD, Azure SQL).
- Built a precision segmentation platform processing 1B+ transactions/year from 21M loyalty members, powering $42M annual incremental revenue; the architecture became the backbone for Loblaw Media ($40M annual revenue).
- Designed Loblaw's first ML decisioning engine for pricing and markdown timing: $15-20M (~25%) annual revenue lift; microservices orchestration framework cut batch latency 73%.

### Numeris (Feb 2017 - Jan 2019) - Research Analyst, PPM Platform Engineering

- Automated ingestion and quality monitoring of national audience measurement data covering ~27M individuals: throughput up 90%+, manual processing eliminated.

### University of Toronto (May 2014 - Sep 2015) - Research Analyst, Faculty of Medicine

- Built ETL and warehousing pipelines analyzing research output across 1,600+ principal investigators and 5,000 faculty.
